cards.originalTitle: Modelling Regime Shifts in Continuous Intraday Electricity Markets with State-dependent Hawkes Processes
keyPointsEn: A multivariate state-dependent Hawkes process is proposed, where state transitions change intensity parameters via the LSI, producing piecewise dynamics.
Estimates on Dutch XBID hourly order data from January to March 2024 show strongly self-exciting and near-critical order flow.
Executed trades trigger new same-side orders while the reverse effect is negligible; liquidity stress mainly strengthens transaction self-excitation rather than reshaping cross-side structure.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The modeling framework helps understand order flow behavior in intraday electricity markets under different liquidity states and offers a state-conditioned approach for market stress monitoring and order flow modeling.
cards.description: 该研究提出多变量状态依赖Hawkes过程，用流动性压力指数识别市场状态，并允许状态转移改变强度参数。基于2024年1-3月荷兰日内跨境小时订单数据校准，发现订单流强自激且接近临界，流动性压力主要增强交易自激而非改变跨侧结构。
cards.summaryEn: The paper applies a state-dependent Hawkes process to order flow in continuous intraday electricity markets, using a proposed Liquidity Stress Index (LSI) to partition market states. Calibration results show strongly self-exciting, near-critical order flow, where executed trades trigger new same-side orders while the reverse effect is negligible. The authors argue that conditioning on liquidity stress is valuable, but a single-exponential specification has limitations when event frequencies are highly imbalanced.
cards.whyItMatters: 该建模框架有助于理解不同流动性状态下日内电力市场订单流行为，为市场压力监测和订单流建模提供状态条件化思路。
cards.limitations: 结果基于2024年1-3月荷兰XBID小时订单数据，样本期和区域有限。状态划分依赖所提出的LSI与三状态选择，稳健性检验显示结果由状态构造驱动；替代指数组成仅在窄带内拟合，三状态优于两状态，去除状态后拟合明显差于单状态Hawkes基准。单指数设定在高频不平衡事件下存在局限。
cards.titleEn: Modelling Order Flow in Intraday Electricity Markets with State-dependent Hawkes Processes
cards.limitationsEn: Results are based on Dutch XBID hourly order data from January to March 2024, with limited sample period and region. State partitioning relies on the proposed LSI and a three-state choice; robustness checks show results are driven by regime construction: alternative index compositions fit within a narrow band, three states fit better than two, and removing states clearly degrades the fit relative to a single-regime Hawkes benchmark. A single-exponential specification has limitations when event frequencies are highly imbalanced.
keyPoints: 提出多变量状态依赖Hawkes过程，状态转移通过LSI改变强度参数，形成分段动态。
基于2024年1-3月荷兰XBID小时订单数据的估计显示订单流强自激且接近临界。
已执行交易触发同侧新订单，反向效应可忽略；流动性压力主要增强交易自激而非重塑跨侧结构。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a multivariate state-dependent Hawkes process that uses a Liquidity Stress Index to identify market states and allows state transitions to change intensity parameters. Calibrated on Dutch intraday cross-border hourly order data from January to March 2024, it finds strongly self-exciting, near-critical order flow, with liquidity stress mainly strengthening transaction self-excitation rather than reshaping cross-side structure.
cards.title: 基于状态依赖Hawkes过程的日内电力市场订单流建模
cards.summary: 论文将状态依赖Hawkes过程用于日内连续电力市场订单流建模，并用所提出的流动性压力指数（LSI）划分市场状态。校准结果显示订单流强自激、接近临界，已执行交易触发同侧新订单而反向效应可忽略。作者认为条件化于流动性压力有价值，但单指数设定在高频不平衡事件下存在局限。

keyPointsEn: The Kelly objective decomposes into money, entropy, and divergence terms; maximizing growth is equivalent to minimizing the divergence (in bits) between predicted and true distributions.
In backtests, the difference in log growth between two strategies measures their relative divergence because money and entropy terms are constant across strategies.

A winner fraction heuristic is introduced that allocates capital in proportion to each asset's probability of dominating the candidate set, with its growth shortfall bounded by the entropy of the winner fraction distribution.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The decomposition provides an information-theoretic framework for understanding portfolio growth, translating strategy performance differences into quantifiable distributional divergence and potentially inspiring new portfolio construction methods.
cards.description: 作者借用通用投资组合算法的技巧，将凯利目标分解为资金项、熵项和散度项，表明最大化增长等价于最小化预测分布与真实分布之间的散度（以比特计）。这提供了一个将投资问题视为压缩问题的理论视角，并导出了两个实用副产品：回测中策略间对数增长差异等于其相对散度；一个按资产主导概率分配资金的“赢家比例”启发式，其增长不足可由赢家比例分布的熵界定。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: the author shows that the Kelly objective can be decomposed into a money term, an entropy term, and a divergence term, and that maximizing growth is equivalent to minimizing divergence. Author's view: investing is fundamentally a compression problem, and on this basis proposes a winner fraction heuristic and an entropy bound, claimed as original contributions.
cards.whyItMatters: 该分解为理解投资组合增长提供了信息论框架，将策略表现差异转化为可量化的分布散度，并可能启发新的组合构建方法。
cards.limitations: 该工作为理论推导，未提供实证回测或实际市场数据验证；赢家比例启发式和熵界为作者自称的新结果，尚未经过独立检验；分解依赖已知真实分布等理想化假设，实际应用需考虑估计误差和模型风险。
cards.titleEn: Investing Is Compression: A Three-Term Decomposition of the Kelly Objective
cards.limitationsEn: The work is theoretical and lacks empirical backtesting or real market data validation; the winner fraction heuristic and entropy bound are self-claimed new results not yet independently verified; the decomposition relies on idealized assumptions such as known true distributions, and practical application must account for estimation error and model risk.
keyPoints: 凯利目标分解为资金项、熵项和散度项，最大化增长等价于最小化预测与真实分布的散度（比特）。
回测中两策略对数增长差异度量其相对散度，因资金和熵项对策略恒定。
提出赢家比例启发式，按资产主导候选集的概率分配资金，其增长不足由赢家比例分布的熵界定。
cards.descriptionEn: Borrowing a trick from the universal portfolio algorithm, the author decomposes the Kelly objective into a money term, an entropy term, and a divergence term, showing that maximizing growth is equivalent to minimizing the divergence (in bits) between the predicted distribution and the true distribution. This offers a theoretical view of investing as a compression problem and yields two practical byproducts: in backtests, the difference in log growth between two strategies mea
cards.title: 投资即压缩：凯利准则的三项分解
cards.summary: 事实：作者展示凯利目标可分解为资金项、熵项和散度项，且最大化增长等价于最小化散度。作者观点：投资本质上是一个压缩问题，并据此提出赢家比例启发式和熵界，自称为原创贡献。

cards.originalTitle: STOCK-JEPA: Prior-Anchored Latent Revision Representation Learning in Equity Markets
keyPointsEn: Stock-JEPA uses multi-horizon return and risk statistics from a low-complexity financial model as fixed priors, projected into the target encoder's latent space as anchors.

A context-conditioned revision predictor estimates predictable displacement of the future representation from the anchor; the anchor and revision branches are updated with separate losses, and a downstream readout evaluates cross-sectional ranking and portfolio performance on frozen representations.

The authors prove that the optimal revision reduces the prior anchor's expected squared error by the expected squared norm of the revision vector, and report outperformance over 13 strong baselines on five metrics across China and U.S. equity universes.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Equity market data have a low signal-to-noise ratio; black-box deep models can overfit noise and lack explicit economic structure, while classic linear financial models are interpretable but fail to capture non-linear signals. Stock-JEPA offers a path to combine structural financial priors with deep representation learning, potentially improving representation robustness and interpretability and providing a reference for feature construction and portfolio evaluation in quantitative research.
cards.description: 该研究提出Stock-JEPA框架，将低复杂度金融模型提供的多期收益与风险统计作为锚点，映射到目标编码器的潜在空间，再通过上下文条件修正预测器估计未来表征相对锚点的可预测偏移。其新意在于用结构性先验约束黑箱表征学习，同时保留可解释参照；作者报告在2008年至2022年的中国和美国股票集合上，模型在五项关键指标上优于13个强基线，消融研究也表明学习到的修正具有表征价值。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: Stock-JEPA adopts a joint-embedding predictive framework: a low-complexity financial model generates multi-horizon return and risk statistics, a prior projector maps them as anchors into the target encoder's latent space, and a context-conditioned revision predictor estimates predictable displacement of the future representation from the anchor; separate losses update the anchor and revision branches, and a downstream readout is trained on frozen representations and evaluated through cross-sectional ranking and portfolio performance. The authors theoretically prove that the optimal revision reduces the prior anchor's expected squared error for the same future representation by exactly the expected squared norm of the revision vector. Author's view: this design combines the interpretability of classic linear financial models with deep models' ability to capture non-linear signals, and experiments show it outperforms 13 strong baselines on large-scale China and U.S. equity universes, with ablation and representation analyses demonstrating the value of learned revisions for equity market representation learning.
cards.whyItMatters: 股票市场数据信噪比低，黑箱深度模型容易过拟合噪声且缺乏明确经济结构，而经典线性金融模型可解释却难以捕捉非线性信号。Stock-JEPA提供了一种将结构性金融先验与深度表征学习结合的路径，可能改善表征稳健性和可解释性，并为量化研究中的特征构建与组合评估提供参考。
cards.limitations: 证据边界：原文仅以arXiv摘要形式提供信息，未说明具体13个基线名称、5项评价指标定义、两家股票集合的样本区间、交易成本、涨跌停与流动性限制、数据泄漏控制方式，也未给出统计显著性检验和多重比较校正。理论证明针对同一未来表征的期望平方误差减少，其非负性来自修正向量平方期望，不直接保证组合收益或风险调整后表现提升。实验结论基于作者自选的中国和美国股票集合，未经独立复现，未讨论跨市场、跨时期稳定性、容量约束或交易可行性。下游评估采用冻结表征加读出模块，未排除读出模块容量与训练细节对结果的影响。该框架依赖低复杂度金融模型产生先验，先验选择偏差与参数敏感性未在摘要中说明。
cards.titleEn: Stock-JEPA: Prior-Anchored Latent Revision Representation Learning in Equity Markets
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: the source is only an arXiv abstract, which does not specify the 13 baseline names, the definitions of the five evaluation metrics, the sample period for the two equity universes, transaction costs, price limits and liquidity constraints, data leakage controls, or statistical significance tests and multiple-comparison corrections. The theoretical proof concerns the reduction in expected squared error for the same future representation, and its non-negativity comes from the expected squared norm of the revision vector; it does not directly guarantee improved portfolio returns or risk-adjusted performance. The experimental conclusions are based on the authors' chosen China and U.S. equity universes without independent replication, and cross-market, cross-period stability, capacity constraints, and trading feasibility are not discussed. Downstream evaluation uses frozen representations plus a readout, so the influence of readout capacity and training details on results is not ruled out. The framework depends on a low-complexity financial model to produce priors, and prior selection bias and parameter sensitivity are not addressed in the abstract.
keyPoints: Stock-JEPA以低复杂度金融模型产生的多期收益与风险统计作为固定先验，经投影后作为目标编码器潜在空间中的锚点。
上下文条件修正预测器估计未来表征相对锚点的可预测偏移，锚点与修正分支分别用不同损失更新，下游读出模块在冻结表征上评估横截面排序与组合表现。
作者证明最优修正使先验锚点的期望平方误差减少修正向量的期望平方范数，并在中国和美国股票集合的5项指标上优于13个强基线。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes Stock-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive framework that uses multi-horizon return and risk statistics from a low-complexity financial model as anchors in the target encoder's latent space, and estimates predictable displacement from the anchor via a context-conditioned revision predictor. Its novelty lies in constraining black-box representation learning with structural priors while retaining an interpretable reference; the authors report that on China and
cards.title: Stock-JEPA：以金融先验为锚的潜在修正表征学习
cards.summary: 事实：Stock-JEPA采用联合嵌入预测框架，先由低复杂度金融模型生成多期收益和风险统计，经先验投影器映射为目标编码器潜在空间中的锚点；再由上下文条件修正预测器估计未来表征相对锚点的可预测偏移；两类损失分别更新锚点和修正分支；下游读出模块在冻结表征后通过横截面排序和组合表现评估。作者从理论上证明最优修正使先验锚点对同一未来表征的期望平方误差减少恰好等于修正向量的期望平方范数。作者观点：该设计能结合经典线性金融模型的可解释性与深度模型捕捉非线性信号的能力，实验在中国和美国大规模股票集合上优于13个强基线，消融和表征分析显示学习到的修正对股票市场表征学习有价值。

cards.originalTitle: Soft Strategy Selection for Batch-Mode Active Learning
keyPointsEn: FractAL infers per-strategy reward using influence-function-based data attribution, requiring no retraining, then allocates batch budget via online mirror descent.

Across 7 setups covering classification, regression, and genetic perturbation effect prediction, every existing strategy selection method underperforms random sampling on at least one setup, while FractAL matches or outperforms all baselines including random sampling on every setup.
FractAL automatically concentrates budget on the strongest strategies and prunes the weakest, suitable for deployments where the optimal strategy is unknown in advance.
cards.whyItMattersEn: In high-throughput experiments such as genetic perturbation screens and directed evolution, active learning runs have few rounds and large batches, making the overhead of exploring strategies across rounds prohibitive. FractAL softly mixes strategies within a single batch, avoiding extra exploration overhead, making active learning more practical and potentially advancing its use in modern scientific discovery.
cards.description: 针对批量主动学习中预先选择采集策略的难题，提出软策略选择框架FractAL，利用影响函数归因和在线镜像下降，无需重训练即可在多策略间动态分配批量预算。在7个分类、回归和遗传扰动效应预测基准上，FractAL匹配或超越所有基线，为高吞吐实验等少轮次大批次场景提供实用方案。
cards.summaryEn: The source notes that deploying active learning typically requires choosing an acquisition strategy before any labels, but strategy performance varies and existing selection methods spend many rounds exploring. The authors propose soft strategy selection—using multiple strategies within a single batch—and FractAL, which infers per-strategy reward via influence functions and computes budget shares with online mirror descent. Benchmarks show FractAL is no worse than random sampling and all baselines across 7 settings, concentrating budget on strong strategies.
cards.whyItMatters: 高吞吐实验如遗传扰动筛选和定向进化中，主动学习轮次少、批量大，传统策略选择浪费轮次探索的代价过高。FractAL在单批次内软混合策略，避免额外探索开销，使主动学习更实用，有望推动其在现代科学发现中的应用。
cards.limitations: 结果基于7个特定基准设定，未覆盖所有数据集、代理模型或批量规模。影响函数归因的有效性依赖模型假设，当代理模型或数据分布显著偏离时，策略回报推断可能不准。基准中未涉及在线部署或极端预算约束下的表现。原文未提供失败案例或负结果。
cards.titleEn: FractAL: Soft Strategy Selection for Batch-Mode Active Learning
cards.limitationsEn: Results are based on 7 specific benchmark setups and do not cover all datasets, surrogate models, or batch sizes. The validity of influence-function attribution relies on model assumptions; when the surrogate model or data distribution deviates significantly, inferred strategy rewards may be inaccurate. Online deployment or extreme budget constraints are not tested. No failure cases or negative results are reported.
keyPoints: FractAL通过影响函数归因推断每个策略的回报，无需额外模型重训练，再用在线镜像下降分配批量预算。
在7个覆盖分类、回归和遗传扰动效应预测的设定中，每个现有策略选择方法至少在一个设定上不如随机采样，而FractAL在所有设定上匹配或超越包括随机采样在内的基线。
FractAL能自动将预算集中于表现最好的策略并淘汰最弱策略，适合多策略可用但最优策略未知的部署场景。
cards.descriptionEn: To address the challenge of pre-selecting acquisition strategies in batch active learning, this work proposes soft strategy selection and FractAL, which uses influence-function-based attribution and online mirror descent to dynamically allocate batch budget across strategies without retraining. Across 7 benchmarks spanning classification, regression, and genetic perturbation effect prediction, FractAL matches or outperforms all baselines, offering a practical solution for few
cards.title: 批量主动学习新方法FractAL避免策略选择开销
cards.summary: 原文指出，实际部署主动学习时必须在未标注数据前选定采集策略，而策略性能因数据集和代理模型而异，现有选择方法需多轮探索，开销大。为此作者提出软策略选择，在单一批次内混合使用多个策略，并用FractAL通过影响函数推断每个策略的回报，用在线镜像下降计算预算份额。基准测试显示，FractAL在7个设定中均不劣于随机采样和所有基线，能集中预算于强策略。

cards.originalTitle: FactorBench: A Portfolio-Aware Benchmark for Automated Factor Mining
keyPointsEn: Covers roughly five thousand mined factors, nine automated methods, and five equity markets under a shared data and evaluation contract.
Evaluates factor validity, temporal generalization, predictiveness beyond risk and style exposures, method-pool distinctness, and after-cost portfolio performance.
Concludes that no paradigm consistently dominates across all evaluated dimensions.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Many automated factor mining approaches exist, but their cross-paradigm generalizability, distinctness, and economic usefulness have lacked a unified comparison. FactorBench offers a portfolio-aware evaluation framework to help researchers judge whether methodological advances translate into signal quality and after-cost portfolio performance, without constituting investment advice.
cards.description: FactorBench 是一个面向组合的基准，用于比较九种自动化因子挖掘方法在五个股票市场约五千个因子的表现。其新意在于统一的评估契约连接异构发现算法与信号组合及组合构建流程，并从因子有效性、时序泛化、风险与风格暴露后预测力及方法池独特性等层面追踪输出，有助于判断因子挖掘进展是否转化为可用信号与组合表现。
cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces FactorBench, a portfolio-aware benchmark comparing about five thousand factors mined by nine automated methods across five equity markets. It traces outputs across factor validity, temporal generalization, predictiveness beyond measured risk and style exposures, within- and across-method pool distinctness, composite-signal quality, and after-cost long-only and long-short portfolio performance. The authors report that no paradigm consistently dominates; this is their conclusion based on the benchmark.
cards.whyItMatters: 自动化因子挖掘方法众多，但跨范式的可泛化性、独特性与经济有用性此前缺乏统一比较。FactorBench 提供了组合感知的评估框架，帮助研究者判断方法进展是否转化为信号质量与扣费后组合表现，但不构成任何投资建议。
cards.limitations: 该基准覆盖九个自动化挖掘方法、五个股票市场与约五千个因子，结论受所选方法、市场、评估契约、因子池构建及回测设置影响。论文报告无范式始终占优，但未说明是否在全部市场、时段与成本假设下稳健；证据范围限于所评估的样本与基准设计，不应外推为所有因子挖掘方法或所有市场的通用结论。
cards.titleEn: FactorBench: A Portfolio-Aware Benchmark for Automated Factor Mining
cards.limitationsEn: The benchmark covers nine automated mining methods, five equity markets, and about five thousand factors, so conclusions depend on the selected methods, markets, evaluation contract, factor-pool construction, and backtest settings. The reported absence of a consistently dominant paradigm is not shown to be robust across all markets, periods, and cost assumptions; the evidence is limited to the evaluated sample and benchmark design and should not be generalized to all factor mining methods or markets.
keyPoints: 覆盖约五千个挖掘因子、九种自动化方法与五个股票市场，使用共享数据与评估契约。
评估涵盖因子有效性、时序泛化、风险与风格暴露后预测力、方法池独特性以及扣费后组合表现。
结论为没有一种范式在所有评估维度上持续占优。
cards.descriptionEn: FactorBench is a portfolio-aware benchmark that compares roughly five thousand mined factors from nine automated factor mining methods across five equity markets. Its novelty lies in a shared data and evaluation contract that connects heterogeneous discovery algorithms to common signal combination and portfolio construction procedures and traces outputs across factor validity, temporal generalization, predictiveness beyond risk and style exposures, and pool distinctness, help
cards.title: FactorBench：面向组合的自动化因子挖掘基准
cards.summary: 论文提出 FactorBench，一个面向组合的基准，比较九种自动化挖掘方法在五个股票市场约五千个因子。基准从因子有效性、时序泛化、风险与风格暴露后预测力、方法池内及方法间独特性、复合信号质量及扣费后多空与纯多头组合表现三层追踪输出。作者报告称没有一种范式始终占优；这是其基于该基准的结论。

cards.originalTitle: AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems
keyPointsEn: The Watchdog agent collects runtime telemetry, while the Repair agent uses LLMs to automatically create, test, and deploy code patches.
It adopts a parallel shadow patching non-intrusive execution model based on the MAPE-K loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments.

Across five failure scenarios, it reports average MTTR reduced from 170 minutes to 3.2 minutes, a 92% patch success rate, including 96% for JSON schema changes, 98% for punctuation drift, and 85% for Shadow DOM.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This framework closes the loop between detection and resolution, potentially significantly shortening data pipeline repair time, reducing manual operations burden, and shifting engineering effort from firefighting to innovation. Its plugin-style deployment has low intrusiveness on existing pipeline orchestration systems.
cards.description: 提出基于LLM的多智能体框架，通过Watchdog与Repair代理及并行影子补丁机制，在五类故障场景中实现MTTR从170分钟降至3.2分钟。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes AegisFlow, a multi-agent framework for autonomous data pipeline remediation, comprising Watchdog and Repair agents that use LLMs to automatically generate, test, and deploy code patches. The framework employs a parallel shadow patching execution model based on the MAPE-K loop to validate patches in digital twin environments. The authors report that across five failure scenarios, average MTTR dropped from 170 minutes to 3.2 minutes, with a 92% patch success rate, and claim it can free about 98% of data engineering on-call time.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架将检测与修复闭环，可能显著缩短数据管道故障的修复时间，减少人工运维负担，并将工程精力从故障处理转向创新。其插件式部署方式对现有管道编排系统侵入性较低。
cards.limitations: 实验仅覆盖五种常见故障场景，未说明数据集与场景的详细分布；结果由作者报告，缺乏独立复现。Shadow DOM场景成功率最低（85%），表明在复杂或未充分覆盖的故障类型上性能有限。数字孪生环境与实际生产环境的差异可能影响补丁部署效果。论文未讨论LLM生成补丁的安全性与回滚机制。
cards.titleEn: AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems
cards.limitationsEn: The experiments cover only five common failure scenarios, without detailed distribution of datasets and scenarios; results are author-reported and lack independent replication. The lowest success rate in Shadow DOM cases (85%) indicates limited performance on complex or insufficiently covered failure types. Differences between digital twin and actual production environments may affect patch deployment outcomes. The paper does not discuss the safety and rollback mechanisms of LLM-generated patches.
keyPoints: Watchdog代理收集运行时遥测数据，Repair代理基于LLM自动创建、测试并部署代码补丁。
采用基于MAPE-K循环的并行影子补丁非侵入执行模型，在数字孪生环境中生成并验证补丁。
在五类故障场景中报告MTTR平均从170分钟降至3.2分钟，补丁成功率92%，其中JSON模式变更96%、标点漂移98%、Shadow DOM 85%。
cards.descriptionEn: Presents an LLM-based multi-agent framework with Watchdog and Repair agents and parallel shadow patching, reducing MTTR from 170 to 3.2 minutes across five failure scenarios.
cards.title: AegisFlow：面向脆弱数据生态的多智能体自愈框架
cards.summary: 论文提出AegisFlow，一个用于数据管道自主修复的多智能体框架，包含Watchdog和Repair两个代理，通过LLM自动生成、测试和部署代码补丁。该框架采用基于MAPE-K循环的并行影子补丁执行模型，在数字孪生环境中验证补丁。作者报告在五类故障场景中MTTR平均从170分钟降至3.2分钟，补丁成功率92%，并称可释放约98%的数据工程待命时间。

cards.originalTitle: How Execution Assumptions Change Short-Horizon Sharpe Rankings: Evidence from a Synthetic Trading Benchmark
keyPointsEn: Under high volatility, agreement between near-ideal fills and default-stress settings drops to τb=0.21 for short-horizon Sharpe rankings, versus 0.82 in calm conditions.
Seed-bootstrap intervals are wide and overlapping, and the two-asset point estimate differs substantially from wider asset settings.
Rank changes are related to turnover, and comparisons with buy-and-hold also depend on how that anchor is initialized.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If execution assumptions alter not only return levels but also strategy rankings, then LLM trading backtest rankings based on idealized fills may be unreliable. Reporting execution assumptions and rank stability should become standard in short-horizon strategy comparisons.
cards.description: 该研究在合成交易基准中检验：将订单成交假设从理想收盘价改为包含延迟、点差、参与率和冲击等压力设置后，LLM交易策略与经典基线的短期夏普排序是否保持一致。这对避免仅凭回测排名推断策略优劣有直接方法学意义。
cards.summaryEn: The author compares five prompted LLM signal policies and seven classical baselines on identical synthetic price paths under six execution settings, finding that in the high-volatility regime the near-ideal versus default-stress ranking agreement falls to Kendall τb=0.21, compared with 0.82 in the calm regime. Agreement rises as the asset board widens from two to ten, rank changes are related to turnover, and buy-and-hold comparisons depend on how the anchor is initialized. The author concludes that on short horizons an execution convention can change the ranking itself, so strategy comparisons should not report returns alone.
cards.whyItMatters: 如果执行假设不仅改变收益水平，还改变策略排序，那么仅基于理想成交假设的LLM交易回测排名可能不可靠。报告执行假设与排序稳定性，应成为短期策略比较的标准做法。
cards.limitations: 该实验基于合成价格路径和特定LLM/经典策略集，不评估LLM交易技能，也不代表真实市场收益或实盘表现。两个资产上的置信区间较宽且重叠，结论主要是关于排序而非绝对收益。
cards.titleEn: Execution Assumptions Change Short-Horizon Sharpe Rankings: Evidence from a Synthetic Trading Benchmark
cards.limitationsEn: The experiment relies on synthetic price paths and a specific set of LLM and classical policies; it does not assess LLM trading skill and does not represent real-market returns or live performance. Confidence intervals on the two-asset board are wide and overlapping, and the conclusions concern ranking rather than absolute returns.
keyPoints: 高波动下，近理想填充与默认压力设置的短期夏普排序一致性降至τb=0.21，平静时则为0.82。
种子自助法区间宽且重叠，两资产板上的排序一致性点估计与更宽资产设置差异较大。
排序变化与换手率有关，与买入持有的比较也依赖锚的初始化方式。
cards.descriptionEn: This study tests in a synthetic trading benchmark whether changing order-fill assumptions from idealized close prices to stressed settings with latency, spread, participation, and impact alters the short-horizon Sharpe rankings of LLM and classical baselines. It has direct methodological implications for avoiding strategy superiority claims based only on backtest rankings.
cards.title: 执行假设改变短期夏普排序：合成基准证据
cards.summary: 作者用五个LLM信号策略和七个经典基线，在相同的合成价格路径上比较六种执行设置，发现高波动 regime 下近理想执行与默认压力执行的排序一致性很低（Kendall τb=0.21），而平静 regime 下为0.82。同时，资产数量从两个增至十个时排序一致性上升，换手率与排序变化相关，买入持有锚的初始化方式也影响比较。作者结论是短期基准中执行约定可能改变排序本身，策略比较不能只报告收益。

cards.originalTitle: Agent Planning Benchmark: A Diagnostic Framework for Planning Capabilities in LLM Agents
keyPointsEn: APB contains 4,209 multimodal cases across 22 domains and five planning settings, specifically diagnosing planning capabilities rather than end-to-end success.
It reveals systematic weaknesses in long-horizon planning, tool-noise robustness, calibrated refusal, and inference-time refinement across 12 MLLMs.
On 200 ToolSandbox and 200 τ²-bench tasks, APB-guided refinement improves plan correctness, plan grade, and execution metrics.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Existing agent evaluations often report only end-to-end success, making it difficult to distinguish planning failures from execution failures. APB provides a planning-specific diagnostic that complements execution benchmarks upstream, helping localize specific planning weaknesses and enabling independent assessment and improvement of planning versus execution capabilities.
cards.description: 该研究提出智能体规划基准（APB），将规划从执行中分离，以4209个多模态案例覆盖22个领域和五类设置，发现12个MLLM在长程规划、工具噪声鲁棒性、校准拒绝和推理时精炼上的系统性弱点，并验证APB引导的精炼能提升下游执行指标。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The study proposes APB, a planning-specific diagnostic benchmark with 4,209 multimodal cases across 22 domains and five settings, evaluates 12 MLLMs, and validates on 200 ToolSandbox and 200 τ²-bench tasks that APB-guided refinement improves plan correctness, plan grade, and execution metrics. Author's view: APB serves as an upstream diagnostic complement to execution benchmarks, helping distinguish planning from execution failures.
cards.whyItMatters: 现有智能体评估多报告端到端成功，难以区分规划失败与执行失败。APB提供规划专用诊断，可作为执行基准的上游补充，帮助定位规划环节的具体短板，推动规划能力与执行能力的独立评估和改进。
cards.limitations: 证据来自12个MLLM和特定基准任务，结论的普适性需更多模型和场景验证；APB引导精炼的改进仅在三类代表性模型和400个下游任务上验证；未覆盖真实开放环境中的全部规划维度；基准和代码已公开，但社区尚未独立复现。
cards.titleEn: Agent Planning Benchmark: Diagnosing LLM Planning Shortfalls and Tool Robustness
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from 12 MLLMs and specific benchmark tasks, so generalizability requires validation with more models and scenarios; APB-guided refinement improvements are validated only on three representative models and 400 downstream tasks; not all planning dimensions in real open environments are covered; the benchmark and code are public but community-independent replication is pending.
keyPoints: APB包含4209个多模态案例，覆盖22个领域和五种规划设置，专门诊断规划能力而非端到端成功。
在12个MLLM上揭示长程规划、工具噪声鲁棒性、校准拒绝和推理时精炼四方面系统性弱点。
在ToolSandbox和τ²-bench各200个任务上，APB引导的精炼提升规划正确性、等级和执行指标。
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces the Agent Planning Benchmark (APB), which separates planning from execution and uses 4,209 multimodal cases across 22 domains and five settings to reveal systematic weaknesses in long-horizon planning, tool-noise robustness, calibrated refusal, and inference-time refinement across 12 MLLMs, while validating that APB-guided refinement improves downstream execution metrics.
cards.title: 智能体规划基准：诊断LLM规划短板与工具鲁棒性
cards.summary: 事实：研究提出APB规划专用诊断基准，包含4209个多模态案例、22个领域和五种设置，评估12个MLLM，并在ToolSandbox和τ²-bench各200个任务上验证APB引导的精炼能提升规划正确性、等级和执行指标。作者观点：APB可作为执行基准的上游诊断补充，帮助区分规划与执行失败。

cards.originalTitle: A Functional Representation of Credit Behavior for Probability of Default Modeling
keyPointsEn: Account type, balance, and credit limit are represented as continuous-time processes rather than reduced to monthly aggregated values, yielding a continuous faithful representation of the borrower.

Recurring events associated with the ordinal position among banking days are found to create strong cyclical patterns, and a relative time framework is developed to align these recurring events across borrowers.

The framework is assessed using functional logistic regression, which is reported to attain predictive performance on par with XGBoost while consistently outperforming logistic regression, while retaining the interpretability of linear default models.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the reported predictive-interpretability trade-off holds, financial institutions may be able to adopt default probability models that combine machine learning predictive power with the interpretability of linear models under strict regulatory constraints, thereby easing regulatory limitations on complex model interpretability.
cards.description: 该研究将账户类型、余额与信用额度视为连续时间过程，构建借款人的函数化表示，并引入相对时间框架对齐不同借款人的周期性事件。新意在于保留月内连续信息而非月度聚合，并以函数逻辑回归实现可解释的违约预测；其有用性在于在保持线性模型可解释性的同时，预测表现接近 XGBoost。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes a framework for probability of default modeling via functional data analysis, representing a series of credit variables as functions and investigating whether intra-monthly information improves default predictability in linear models. The authors show that widely used variables such as available funds, utilization rate, and overdraft can all be derived from three quantities observed over time: account type, account balance, and credit limit. The authors report that functional logistic regression, when equipped with an effective functional representation, attains predictive performance on par with XGBoost while consistently outperforming ordinary logistic regression; this conclusion is the authors' report based on their framework.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该框架的预测与可解释性权衡成立，金融机构可能在严格监管约束下采用兼具机器学习预测能力与线性模型可解释性的违约概率模型，从而缓解监管对复杂模型可解释性的限制。
cards.limitations: 证据来自论文所报告的函数逻辑回归评估，未说明数据来源、样本范围、时间跨度、外部验证与统计显著性细节。函数逻辑回归相对 XGBoost 的预测表现相当这一结论，限于作者所用框架与数据，不宜直接外推至其他机构、地区或监管环境。摘要未讨论计算成本、缺失值处理、监管验收细节与潜在过拟合风险，也未提供可复现的基准比较。
cards.titleEn: A Functional Representation of Credit Behavior for Probability of Default Modeling
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes from the functional logistic regression evaluation reported in the paper, without details on data sources, sample scope, time span, external validation, or statistical significance. The conclusion that functional logistic regression performs on par with XGBoost is limited to the authors' framework and data and should not be directly extrapolated to other institutions, regions, or regulatory environments. The abstract does not discuss computational cost, missing value handling, regulatory acceptance details, or potential overfitting risks, nor does it provide reproducible benchmark comparisons.
keyPoints: 以连续时间过程表示账户类型、余额与信用额度，而非压缩为月度聚合值，形成对借款人的连续忠实表示。
发现与银行工作日序位相关的重复事件产生强周期模式，并开发相对时间框架在不同借款人之间对齐这些周期事件。
采用函数逻辑回归评估框架，报告其预测表现与 XGBoost 相当且持续优于逻辑回归，同时保留线性违约模型的可解释性。
cards.descriptionEn: The study treats account type, balance, and credit limit as continuous-time processes to build a functional representation of borrowers, and introduces a relative time framework to align recurring events across borrowers. Its novelty lies in retaining intra-month continuous information rather than monthly aggregates and using functional logistic regression for interpretable default prediction; its usefulness lies in combining near-XGBoost predictive performance with the inter
cards.title: 用函数化信用行为刻画违约概率的新框架
cards.summary: 论文提出一个基于函数数据分析的违约概率建模框架，把一系列信用变量表示为函数，考察月内信息是否提升线性模型的违约预测能力。作者说明可用资金、使用率和透支等常用变量可由三类随时间观测的量导出：账户类型、账户余额和信用额度。作者报告函数逻辑回归在有效函数表示下预测表现与 XGBoost 相当，并持续优于普通逻辑回归；该结论属于作者基于其框架的报告。

cards.originalTitle: Adversarial Training for Deep Hedging in Nonstationary Markets
keyPointsEn: WRAP derives from a two-budget DRO formulation, using a weighted empirical reference distribution to balance sampling uncertainty against temporal drift.
The ambiguity set simultaneously addresses φ-divergence reweighting and optimal-transport path perturbation as two complementary forms of distributional misspecification.
A first-order expansion decomposes the nominal expected loss increase into a reweighting term and a transport term, yielding a tractable finite-dimensional adversarial attack.
cards.whyItMattersEn: In nonstationary markets, deep hedging policies relying only on fixed historical paths may underestimate losses from distributional drift. This framework provides an actionable joint training scheme of reweighting and path perturbation, helping researchers evaluate and train hedging policies under model uncertainty.
cards.description: 该工作提出 WRAP 框架，用重加权与路径扰动两类对抗约束应对深度对冲训练中的市场非平稳性，其新意在于将 DRO 内层上确界转化为可计算的一阶攻击，为训练策略提供更稳健的扰动方式。
cards.summaryEn: Deep hedging learns trading policies from historical or simulated paths, but under nonstationarity these paths may not represent future markets. The authors propose WRAP based on two-budget distributionally robust optimization, allowing trajectory reweighting under a φ-divergence constraint and path perturbation under an optimal-transport constraint, and derive a first-order expansion with an explicit finite-dimensional adversarial attack. Experiments on stationary and nonstationary Heston dynamics and a generalized affine diffusion show complementary benefits from reweighting and transport, with joint adversarial training yielding the largest gains under nonstationarity.
cards.whyItMatters: 非平稳市场中，深度对冲策略若只依赖固定历史路径，可能低估分布漂移带来的损失。该框架给出一种可操作的重加权与路径扰动联合训练思路，有助于研究者在模型不确定性下评估和训练对冲策略。
cards.limitations: 原文仅基于摘要信息，具体理论假设、算法细节、数值实验设置与统计显著性未在输入中给出。结论限于平稳与非平稳 Heston 及广义仿射扩散等设定，不能直接外推到真实市场或其他资产类别。该工作属于方法研究，不构成任何交易或投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Adversarial Training for Deep Hedging via Two-Budget Distributionally Robust Optimization
cards.limitationsEn: The original input provides only summary information; specific theoretical assumptions, algorithmic details, numerical experiment settings, and statistical significance are not given. Conclusions are limited to stationary and nonstationary Heston dynamics and a generalized affine diffusion setup, and cannot be directly extrapolated to real markets or other asset classes. This is methodological research and does not constitute any trading or investment advice.
keyPoints: WRAP 源自双预算 DRO，以加权经验参考分布平衡采样不确定性与时间漂移。
模糊集同时包含 φ-散度重加权和最优传输路径扰动两类分布误设。
一阶展开将名义期望损失增量分解为重加权项与传输项，并导出可处理的有限维对抗攻击。
cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes WRAP, a framework that combines reweighting and path perturbation adversarial constraints to address market nonstationarity in deep hedging training. Its novelty lies in converting the inner distributional supremum of DRO into a tractable first-order attack, offering a more robust perturbation scheme for training policies.
cards.title: 基于双预算分布鲁棒优化的深度对冲对抗训练
cards.summary: 深度对冲依赖历史或模拟路径学习交易策略，但在非平稳市场中这些路径未必代表未来。作者基于双预算分布鲁棒优化提出 WRAP，同时允许按 φ-散度对轨迹重加权和按最优传输约束扰动路径，并给出一阶展开与显式有限维对抗攻击。实验在平稳与非平稳 Heston 及广义仿射扩散下显示，重加权与传输具有互补收益，联合对抗训练在非平稳条件下提升最大。

cards.originalTitle: HF Buckets: Upload Only What Changed with Xet
keyPointsEn: Xet storage layer uses content-defined chunking to achieve incremental uploads, transferring only changed data chunks.
In the demo, CSV appending and Parquet prepending operations result in slight data transfers, saving about 90% bandwidth.
Using PyArrow 21+'s use_content_defined_chunking parameter optimizes Parquet file synchronization.
cards.whyItMattersEn: For teams frequently updating large datasets, this technology avoids re-uploading identical data, saving bandwidth and time, thus enabling more efficient dataset version maintenance and faster iteration cycles.
cards.description: Hugging Face 的 Xet 存储层可在数据变更时只上传变化部分，而不是重新上传整个文件。对于频繁更新大型数据集的用户，这能显著节省带宽和时间，提升工作效率。
cards.summaryEn: The video demonstrates how Hugging Face's Xet storage layer uploads only changed parts of files. Specifically, after uploading a 191 MB CSV and appending 100 rows, only new data is transferred; after converting to Parquet and prepending 100 rows, only 8.6 MB of a 52.9 MB file is sent. The author finds this useful for engineers who regularly update datasets.
cards.whyItMatters: 对于需要频繁更新大型数据集的团队，该技术避免了重复上传相同数据，节省带宽和时间，从而更高效地维护数据集版本，加速迭代周期。
cards.limitations: 演示仅基于特定工具和版本，实际节省效果可能因数据变更模式、文件格式和工具链而异。未深入讨论并发、版本冲突或长期存储成本等生产环境问题。
cards.titleEn: Hugging Face Xet Storage Layer Enables Incremental Uploads
cards.limitationsEn: The demo is based on specific tools and versions; actual savings may vary with data change patterns, file formats, and toolchains. Production issues like concurrency, version conflicts, or long-term storage costs are not deeply discussed.
keyPoints: Xet 存储层通过内容定义分块实现增量上传，只传输变化的数据块。
演示中 CSV 追加和 Parquet 前置操作分别只上传了少量新数据，节省约 90% 带宽。
使用 PyArrow 21+ 的 use_content_defined_chunking 参数可优化 Parquet 文件同步。
cards.descriptionEn: Hugging Face's Xet storage layer uploads only changed data pieces instead of re-uploading entire files when data changes. For users frequently updating large datasets, this saves bandwidth and time, improving workflow efficiency.
cards.title: Hugging Face Xet 存储层实现增量上传
cards.summary: 该视频演示了 Hugging Face 的 Xet 存储层如何只上传文件变更部分。具体展示了上传 191 MB CSV 并追加 100 行后，仅新数据被传输；转换为 Parquet 并前置 100 行后，52.9 MB 文件仅传输 8.6 MB。作者认为这对经常更新数据集的工程师很有用。

keyPointsEn: The course is offered by DeepLearning.AI in partnership with Qdrant, taught by Dylan Couzon.
The core topic is building AI assistants with memory entirely on-device, without network connection or remote server.
A free enrollment link is provided, aimed at developers interested in on-device memory.
cards.whyItMattersEn: On-device memory can help run AI assistants in offline or privacy-sensitive scenarios, reducing reliance on cloud services and potentially lowering data leakage risks. The course offers developers an opportunity to learn such implementations.
